# Remote work policy

Last reviewed: 2025-11-04

## Eligibility

Employees who have completed their first 90 days may work remotely
up to two days per week. Managers approve exceptions
in writing. Roles that require on-site equipment are excluded.

## Equipment

The company provides one laptop and one monitor.

# Remote work policy

Last reviewed: 2026-09-16

## Eligibility

Employees who have completed their first 60 days may work remotely
up to three days per week. Team leads approve exceptions
in writing, and HR is copied on every approval.
Roles that require on-site equipment are excluded.

## Equipment

The company provides one laptop and one monitor.
